selection_rule: Evidence and design quality only; no confirmatory effect direction, magnitude, or statistical significance was inspected.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: Public minute-level occupancy data permit fixed-schedule and sensing-based lighting policies to be compared under explicit energy and false-off constraints.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: One office-room dataset collected in 2015 limits external validity and no building switching-cost ledger is observed.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: NASA run-to-failure simulations permit fixed-age and condition-informed maintenance policies to be evaluated with common failure and maintenance-loss functions.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: C-MAPSS is an older simulated benchmark and cannot establish realized fleet savings or safety outcomes.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: Interval load and price data plus DOE evidence on AMI-enabled rates permit flat and time-varying tariff objectives to be compared with explicit distributional and transition constraints.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: The system data end in 2020 and do not identify household behavioral response without external experimental evidence.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: FAO crop-water methods and complete daily meteorology permit calendar and weather-adaptive irrigation schedules to be compared under crop-water-deficit constraints.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: Results will be a model-based agronomic counterfactual rather than an observed farm intervention.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: FHWA definitions and complete NYC hourly count profiles permit a transparent pre-timed versus responsive signal-control sensitivity analysis.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: The counts end in 2021 and cannot verify the deployed timing plan or all intersection geometry and safety constraints; no redesign recommendation is permitted.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: ISO container dimensions provide a deliberately high-network-cost comparator where compatibility can rationally dominate technical re-optimization.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: No universal current engineering objective or public asset-level transition ledger supports a quantitative redesign optimum.

frozen_cases.selection_rationale: ISO A-series paper provides an analytic null: the square-root-of-two aspect ratio preserves shape under halving and should remain optimal for that unchanged objective.
frozen_cases.preconfirmatory_limit: The result tests a narrow geometric objective and must not be generalized to all printing or document-use objectives.
